dedupe_keys.name: brainport highway pilot road side camera detection

description: The AUTOPILOT project partners publish roadside-camera and connected-vehicle observations from the Automotive Campus test track in the Netherlands. Zenodo supplies draft and final archive packages free under CC BY 4.0. The description covers a ten-minute obstacle scenario with camera detections, absolute and relative object positions, GPS, vehicle controls and hazard messages. These observations can benchmark perception and communication components in automated-driving simulations. Related G6 data-autopilot-livorno-connected-roadworks-logs records a separate Italian demonstration. Coverage is the Brainport test-track experiment, not general road operation. The four listed archives include draft and final variants and should not be counted as four independent trials. Sensor synchronisation, detection error and internal encodings require checking before reuse. No archive was downloaded or safety-performance claim tested.
